Messages.Author: prophet
Messages.Body:
Hello,
Well another Saturday was spent in on the Jyhad and a few more
questions came up:

When a vamp has Talbott's equipped, but has been reduced to 0
blood, what happens? Does that vamp. go to torpor? Or does he just have
to get rid of the saw?

Hawg: one press each turn. What is a turn? The Tremere Meth. here
says it means each round of combat, but of course he would say that....

Are vamps in torpor eligible for the Hunting Grounds? HOw about
for Sabine Lafite?

We of course are using house rules for these, but any other
opinions/facts on how other people play it would be great to hear, as the
"Holy-Gawdamm-Rulebook*tm" doesn't explain it very well.

--
-prophet

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
prophet <rge...@ucs.indiana.edu> wrote:
> When a vamp has Talbott's equipped, but has been reduced to 0
>blood, what happens? Does that vamp. go to torpor? Or does he just have
>to get rid of the saw?

An empty vampire with T's Chainsaw is stuck. The only action it can
take (hunting) is prohibited by the Chainsaw.

> Hawg: one press each turn. What is a turn? The Tremere Meth. here
>says it means each round of combat, but of course he would say that....

It means turn: untap, master, minion, etc. If the minion gets into
multiple combats in the turn, it will only be able to use the Hawg
in one of them.

> Are vamps in torpor eligible for the Hunting Grounds? HOw about
>for Sabine Lafite?

You can't give blood to them with the Hunting Grounds (card texts), but
Sabine can transfer blood to a Tremere in torpor.

Tom Wylie rec.games.trading-cards.* Network Representative for
aa...@cats.ucsc.edu Wizards of the Coast, Inc.
